title: Hearty Chewy Norwegian Yeast Lefse
description: A traditional Norwegian yeast lefse recipe with a chewy texture and a unique twist using a tandoor oven. This recipe is ayurvedic-sattvic-friendly and perfect for a snack or dessert.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the warm milk and yeast. Let it sit for 5 minutes until the yeast is activated.
Add the flour, coconut oil, honey, and salt to the bowl. Mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover it with a damp cloth, and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
Divide the dough into 6-8 equal pieces. Roll each piece into a ball and then flatten it slightly into a disk shape.
Place the lefse disks in the tandoor oven and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side until they are golden brown.
Brush the lefse with ghee and serve warm.
